model: MG-R Unisex Comfort Bicycle - Heavy Duty
description:
Unisex Bicycle...SUPER DURABLE Version with Easy On, Easy off unisex frame with 24x2.125 Heavy Duty wheels, coaster brake

Unisex Heavy-Duty Comfort Bicycle Built for strength, stability, and everyday comfort, this super-durable version of the Worksman MG Comfort Bicycle features an easy-mount unisex step-through frame and heavy-duty 24" x 2.125" wheels with Worksman Clincher rims, 11-gauge spokes, and a reliable coaster brake. Designed with larger riders in mind, this model offers a solid, confidence-inspiring ride without sacrificing comfort or style. Recommended Upgrades for Heavier Riders: For riders over 260 lbs: add the front drum brake, precision sealed crank set, Kevlar-belted tires, puncture-resistant tubes, and extra-wide saddle (as shown). For riders over 300 lbs: include the solid seatpost and N18 pedals for maximum durability. Enjoy a smooth, ergonomic riding position and the peace of mind that comes from Worksman’s legendary craftsmanship. The perfect choice for riders who want a comfortable, rugged bicycle built to go the distance in style.
